added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the added within-window rate line is not ruff-formatted (ruff format --check would rewrap it); the manifest discloses this and defers the reformat because it would change the scanner's sha256 and invalidate the digest the committed scan records.

follow-on: the after block is compared against the plan's published 29.4% before-rate (392 deaths in 1333 attempts) rather than the before block the same scan produced (393 in 1342, 29.3%); the page discloses the corpus drift, so the comparison is sound, but the headline pairs a plan figure with a fresh scan.

follow-on: the committed stated test's after branch asserts only that the headline count is positive and its population truthy, so it would not catch a rescan that moved the committed after figures; the durable assertion of the window's behaviour lives only in the synthetic-corpus gate.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call sites found: the scanner is a research script run by hand (docs/research/local-lane-death-rate.html:92) and imported only by the new test, so no runtime code reaches the change
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 605a4d9d5: da03f91bd gives build_after_block the headline/within_window_all_efforts/control shape, moves its call after the controls are computed, updates the scanner summary line and every page figure, and adds tests/test_death_scan_after_window.py; 9a1c56f94 adds the 112-line evidence fragment and touches no plan file.
item_verdicts.done_when: §10's done-when asks the after block to state the review count, the death count and rate with its interval, and the before-rate it is compared against; docs/research/data/local-lane-deaths.json now carries after_state measured with after.deaths.headline {count 22, attempts 467, rate 0.0471}, after.rate_ci95 {low 0.031-0.070} and before.deaths.headline 393/1342, which is that measure.
item_verdicts.goal: the node was dispatched to re-run docs/research/scripts/scan_local_lane_deaths.py over the post-move after window and state its after block beside the before block; docs/research/local-lane-death-rate.html:178-197 states 22 deaths in 467 review attempts at high since 2026-09-30T18:36Z (4.7%, Wilson 3.1-7.0%) against the before-rate.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both commits, the four gate arms with their log paths (head stated 7 passed, head windowing 3 passed, base stated 7 passed, base windowing 3 failed EXIT=1), the negative control EXIT=1, and discloses the one in-window attempt dated by mtime and the deferred ruff format.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence grants the data file, the page, the scanner, a new test and an evidence fragment; git diff --name-status 605a4d9d5..9a1c56f94 changes exactly docs/research/data/local-lane-deaths.json, docs/research/local-lane-death-rate.html, docs/research/scripts/scan_local_lane_deaths.py, tests/test_death_scan_after_window.py and the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/.

justifications.durability: removing the after-window filter turns tests/test_death_scan_after_window.py:185 and :208 red (negative-control-window-removed.log EXIT=1, 2 failed), so the added assertions fail on the regression this change exists to prevent.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_death_scan_after_window.py:171-231 pins the window count, death count, Wilson interval and not-measurable state on a synthetic corpus and removing the window filter fails it, while the real committed figures are only shape-checked by tests/test_the_local_lane_death_rate_is_stated.py:206-220.
justifications.fit: build_after_block and its new keys (positive_control, completion_control, within_window_all_efforts) are named by mechanism and mirror the before block; ruff check is clean and the single unformatted line is the disclosed follow-on.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/data/local-lane-deaths.json carries the after window the goal names: after.deaths.headline count 22 of 467, rate 0.0471, Wilson 0.031-0.070, beside the before headline 393 of 1342.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 605a4d9d5..9a1c56f94 changes only the five paths the manifest declares, all inside the node's fence.
